youtube.title: Good Morning Bible Verse | Psalm 90:14 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Ask for this before the day starts.

"O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days." Psalm 90:14 (KJV)

Satisfied early means you don't spend the whole day chasing something to fill you.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
